units.source_text: 先是比目魚張口大笑，老闆娘也隨之哈哈笑出聲，自己也流著淚，羞紅著臉，苦笑起來。

en.t: First Flounder opened his mouth wide and laughed, and the madam burst out laughing too; I also began to smile bitterly, with tears in my eyes and my face flushed.

units.source_text: 「嗯，這樣比較好。」比目魚一臉壞笑地說，

en.t: "Yes, that would be better," Flounder said with a nasty grin,
"You would be better off going somewhere there are no women.

units.source_text: 只要有女人在，你就沒救。

en.t: As long as there are women around, there is no saving you.

units.source_text: 去沒有女人的地方，是個不錯的主意。」沒有女人的地方。

en.t: Going somewhere there are no women is not a bad idea." Somewhere there are no women.

units.source_text: 我愚昧的胡言亂語，日後竟然化作了悲慘的現實。

en.t: My foolish ravings later turned, unbelievably, into a miserable reality.

units.source_text: 良子彷彿覺得我替她喝下了那些毒藥，因此在我面前顯得更加畏縮與拘謹，

en.t: Yoshiko seemed to think that I had drunk those poisons in her place, and because of that she became even more timid and constrained in front of me,

units.source_text: 無論我說什麼，她都不苟言笑，也不怎麼接我的話茬。

en.t: and no matter what I said, she would not smile and hardly answered me at all.
